relations.text: クラウド基盤を提供する戦略パートナーとしてAmazonを挙げている

source.label: NiCE 20-F
source.quote: We rely on cloud computing platforms provided by third parties, including PaaS provided by strategic partners, such as Amazon and Microsoft.

relations.text: CCaaS市場の競合としてAmazon Connectを挙げている

relations.text: NICE Systemsが、JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.を管理代理人とする3億米ドルの優先担保付リボルビング融資枠のクレジット契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: NICE Systems entered into a secured Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent for a $300 million senior secured revolving facility

source.label: NiCE 20-F
source.quote: (“NICE Systems”) entered into a secured Credit Agreement with the lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent (the “Credit Agreement”), which provides for a senior secured revolving facility in an aggregate amount of $300 million USD.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.がADRの預託銀行を務めている
relations.text_en: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is the depositary under the ADR Deposit Agreement

source.label: NiCE 20-F
source.quote: Set forth below is a summary of certain provisions in relation to charges and other payments under the Deposit Agreement, as amended, among NiCE, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as depositary (the “Depositary”), and the owners and holders from time to time of ADRs issued thereunder (the “Deposit Agreement”).
